prompt: Hierarchical edge bundling explorer. Layout switcher: circle pack (d3.pack), treemap (d3.treemap), dendrogram, radial tree, sunburst, icicle. Bundle links with curveBundle and tension slider. Toggle link visibility and link layer order. Click to select nodes, hover to highlight groups. Randomize dataset button. Use keyed .join() with transition interpolation between layouts—never remove and recreate nodes. Style the control bar with clear typographic hierarchy (bold labels, grouped controls). In radial layouts, rotate labels to avoid crowding at the bottom arc.
